items.gis_map_desc: Search, cluster-filter, and inspect QCVN 41 sign data with traffic direction metadata.
items.ai_pipeline_desc: Auto-extract from dashcam video, BoT-SORT object tracking, and pgvector classification.
items.mobile_app_desc: Record GPX field trips and get directional sign alerts matching your lane of travel.
items.reviewer_desc: Peer-review validation mechanism and weighted consensus scoring.
items.credit_desc: Earn rewards for valid data contributions and use credits for premium features.
items.active_learning_desc: Automated loop for refreshing stale signs and periodic AI model retraining.
items.api_desc: PostGIS spatial data API for autonomous vehicle research and logistics applications.
